.github/workflows/code-quality-gates.yml changed since cat-harness/processes/code-quality-gates.bpmn was last attested (agent), and the prose did not. Re-read it; if it still holds, run pairs:attest with a reason.

pair_attestations.reason: Re-read the process documentation against the yml change. The change adds one step, check:code-accounting, inside the TypeScript job. The prose's claim about that box is 'TypeScript IS ONE BOX STANDING FOR ROUGHLY THIRTY REPOSITORY GATES' and lists their families; a thirty-first gate of the same kind is what that sentence already describes, deliberately approximately, so the box's meaning does not move. Nothing about the six-job shape, the four-hard/two-warn asymmetry, continue-on-error or the lane changes: the new step is hard-failing inside an already-hard job, so it adds no warn-only mechanism to keep apart.
